anchors.description: Over-the-range microwave: full front width between its two bottom front corners.
anchors.visible_evidence: Black over-the-range microwave with door and right-hand control panel; its front bottom edge runs from about (345,143) at the left corner to about (555,122) at the right corner, spanning the full appliance between the flanking wood cabinets.
anchors.identity_uncertainty: Exact model not identifiable; nearly all US over-the-range microwaves are 30 in (76.2 cm) wide, with a small chance of 36 in.

anchors.description: Granite countertop depth from the front nosing edge back to the wall/backsplash, taken along one vertical image slice.
anchors.visible_evidence: Continuous granite top surface at x=470; the front nosing edge is at y~334 above the drawer faces and the back edge meets the tile backsplash at y~240, both on the visible top surface.
anchors.identity_uncertainty: US base-cabinet countertops are 25.5-26 in deep (24 in cabinet plus 1.5-2 in overhang), occasionally 24 in; the back point is taken at the tile face, so it may be ~1 cm short.

anchors.description: Built-in gas cooktop front edge width between its front-left and front-right corners.
anchors.visible_evidence: Black gas cooktop with cast grates inset in the granite; front-left corner near (325,303) and front-right corner near (525,323) along the visible front edge, with granite visible outboard of both ends.
anchors.identity_uncertainty: Could be a 30 in (76.2 cm) or 36 in (91.4 cm) residential cooktop; glossy black boundary leaves the corners uncertain by about 8 px.
